property_summary: Scheduling an operation with delay < minDelay must revert; scheduling with delay >= minDelay makes isOperation true and the timestamp equals block.timestamp+delay.
Executing execute(...) either reverts or, if it succeeds, marks the operation done (isOperationDone == true) and sets its timestamp to _DONE_TIMESTAMP (1).
If schedule(...) succeeds (does not revert) then isOperation(id) becomes true and getTimestamp(id) > 0.
